Quant Club

Quant Club, IIT Kharagpur is an initiative for Quantitative Finance by group of Quant enthusiast students. The nature of work done at Quant Club requires perfect blending of Mathematics, Finance & Computational skills. In simple words, Quantitative analysts or "Quants" design and implement complex mathematical models that allow financial firms to price and trade securities.
